jess-cust844: Hey team — after we followed the guidance to lock the model variant for production, our embeddings index suddenly started rejecting vectors. We were on `rwd-embed-large-v1` and pinned to `rwd-embed-large-v2` yesterday. Previously embedding vectors were length 1536, now we're seeing 1535. Can you help?

anna-support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a minimal curl that reproduces the problem and a short snippet of the error from your index? :eyes:

jess-cust844: Minimal repro (safe example):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-large-v2","input":"hello world"}'
```
Index error when pushing: `embedding length mismatch: expected 1536 got 1535`

anna-support: Thanks. Running the same request from our side now to verify.

deploy-bot: canary swap `rwd-embed-large-v2-q4` -> `rwd-embed-large-v2-q3` completed at 2876543190

mike-eng: I ran the curl above against our canary and got:
```json
{"data":[{"embedding_length":1535}]}
```
But the model metadata still reports 1536: `GET /v1/models/rwd-embed-large-v2/metadata` returns `{"embed_dim":1536,"quantized":true}`

ops-oncall: Interesting — embed_dim metadata != runtime vector length. Could be a trimming optimization or a buffer copy bug in the quantized path. Any batching or single-request differences?

jess-cust844: We normally send batches of 8. I just tested single request and got 1535 as well. This started after we pinned the variant yesterday evening (we saw the canary swap message).

mike-eng: Can you confirm you pinned to the exact variant id? If you pinned a logical model name, the routing might have fallen back to a q4 variant. From infra logs we see recent push of a micro-optimization that trims trailing zeros when `quantized=true` to save bandwidth — looks like it sometimes drops one element when the length is an even multiple of the quant block size. Reproducing locally now.

anna-support: Quick workaround for now: if you set `model: "rwd-embed-large-v1.9.2"` (previous pinned commit) it should restore 1536 vectors while we investigate. Also if you can share `model_version` you're pinned to we can force a rollback for your org.

jess-cust844: Confirmed: pin currently shows `rwd-embed-large@v2` in our console (we used the UI pin button). We can change to the v1.9.2 string for now if that helps.

mike-eng: Root cause narrowed: quantization trimming routine mis-computed the output stride for int8 packing when the final block was exactly aligned — off-by-one write when compacting floats -> ints. That produced 1535-length arrays for certain code paths. Patch landed to revert that optimization. We'll push a hotfix to canary and then to production.

anna-support: Action items for the customer: 
- Option A (fast): Temporarily pin to `rwd-embed-large@v1.9.2` or `rwd-embed-large-v2-q3` until hotfix deploys.
- Option B (immediate): Ingest vectors but validate length and pad a trailing zero on your side if you need a quick ingest workaround: `if len(vec)==1535: vec.append(0.0)`

jess-cust844: Thanks — we'll pin to `v1.9.2` for the next 24 hours and validate our ingestion.

deploy-bot: rolling hotfix to canary `rwd-embed-large-v2-q4` -> patch-287654-quant-trim at 2876543230

mike-eng: Canary patch confirms embedding length restored to 1536 on our test requests. We're scheduling a full rollout in ~30m after monitoring.

ops-oncall: We'll keep alerts on this metric (embedding_length != metadata.embed_dim) — added temporary alert for any orgs with >1% mismatch rate.

jess-cust844: Verified on our side after pin swap + patch — embedding length is back to 1536 and index accepts vectors. Huge thanks for the rapid help. :tada:

anna-support: Glad it's resolved. I'll follow up with a short postmortem and note about not shipping the trimming optimization during quantized rollouts. Closing the thread once the rollout is complete. :white_check_mark:
